sloka: राजभोगाननुभवन् महार्हान् पार्थिवात्मज ।विहर त्वमयोध्यायां यथा शक्रस्त्रिविष्टपे ॥ २.१०८.९॥
transliteration: rājabhogānanubhavan mahārhān pārthivātmaja ।vihara tvamayodhyāyāṁ yathā śakrastriviṣṭape ॥ 2.108.9॥

translations.english: O king's son, enjoy inestimable royal pleasures in the city of Ayodhya like Indra in heaven.
